source: derived from results/fairness.json committed per-group rates (no model re-run; existing values unchanged)
note: Complements the existing demographic_parity.ndcg10_gap and equal_opportunity (HitRatio@10 among graduated) keys in fairness.json, which are unchanged. These are the selection-rate DP difference and the TPR-on-relevant EO difference, defined per attribute.
